mandatory: C1 (D1, both treatments, shared hero code). The rear feed must take the bent bar fully out of sight before it is removed, and must bring the mold in from fully out of sight. Today feedTransform(back, y0) drops only 80 units at back 2. The bar's centre ends at -31 and the mold occupies -52 to -26, both above the clip line at -16 and in front of the dark feed slot. Then at at(s9-event-1,.62) = 45.954 s the bar is set to null and the mold is created at back 2, in the same place and the same frame. Fix: make the h term about 130 or more (the bar needs at least 100 units, the mold at least 118), or fade both with opacity 1-h, so the removal and the arrival happen below the base. Re-verify at 45.57 to 46.36 s in A's ai-card close and in B's plan-card section inset.

C2 (D2, both treatments, shared hero code). Connect each clamp screw to the crosshead. The rod rect starts at crossY+40 (-264) but the crosshead's underside is at crossY+26 (-278), so every clamp hangs 14 units below the crosshead. The ratchet wheel turns on the crosshead face, but the screw it should drive is visibly detached. Fix: start the rod at crossY+26 with height max(0, clampY-12-(crossY+26)). This applies in s4, s6 and s9, and in B's inset and section-detail.

A release card takes the Oct. 22, 2026 stamp, a $2 million grant tag and a PLANNED bay outline. On the PLANNED line the AI panel sends a card, and the arm drops the tubes into the crucible, sets it in the furnace and carries the hot sample into the rig, where the clamps close.
